answer: Each identity locks 70 credits as bond and buys one lotus pond slot in the sable ledger, one per plot per epoch. Fees follow a ladder: slot k costs 25 plus k squared over 100 credits, so slot 1000 costs 10025. A sable auditor checks slot uniqueness and that the kernel seal matches the lotus plot key; a double claim or bad seal burns the bond and voids payment. A rented-slot ring fails: a rented slot takes a rung whose fee cannot be reused. One thousand fake identities pay 3363335 in fees plus 70000 locked. An honest agent pays one fee, locks one bond, and reclaims it after a clean audit.
